name: crawlcove-chrome-extension
description: SEO Chrome extension with an AI visibility check: on-page SEO audit of the current tab plus which AI crawlers can read it, snippet blocks, llms.txt and an extractability score. Mirrors the Crawl Cove desktop crawler's checks.

scripts.lint: node --check background.js && node --check content/snapshot.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))" && node --check popup/popup.js && for f in lib/*.js; do node --input-type=module -e "import('./$f')" || exit 1; done
scripts.pack: rm -f dist/seo-chrome-extension.zip && mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/seo-chrome-extension.zip manifest.json background.js content lib popup icons -x '*.DS_Store'

author: Crawl Cove
